name: VCTK: CSTR Voice Cloning Toolkit Corpus
description: The VCTK corpus contains speech data uttered by 110 English speakers with various accents (Scottish, Irish, English, American, Australian, Welsh, Canadian, etc.). Each speaker reads approximately 400 sentences extracted from a herald text, rainbow passage, and elicitation paragraph recorded at 48kHz with omni-directional and directional microphones.
